evidence: SnS was deposited in an atomic layer deposition process previously developed by Kim and George, 27 where precursors of tin(II) 2,4-pentanedionate [Sn (acac) 2, 99.9% purity, SigmaAldrich] and hydrogen sulfide were used to deposit tin sulfide. The H2S was generated in a separate vial through thermal decomposition of thioacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, >99% purity). The homebuilt viscous flow reactor ... was evacuated to a pressure around 100 mTorr, at a 10 SCCM flow of nitrogen carrier gas.
